name: switchboard-kc-web
description: Switchboard KC: an unofficial Kansas City 311 web app and its Cloudflare Worker

ADMIN_TOKEN.description: The owner token for your server. Make a long random string (for example `openssl rand -base64 24`) and keep it: you type it in Settings > Owner tools to pause the server or set its key.

MODE.description: `open` (the default) lets anyone use your server. `off` pauses it.

SUBMIT_DAILY.description: How many reports one person can file through your server in a day.

APP_NAME.description: The name shown in the app.
